section_summary.extract_value: This section details the data analysis methods, including the use of IBM SPSS Statistics (version 23.0) and AMOS software. Pearson product-moment correlation analyses were conducted to explore relationships between BMI, social safeness, body appreciation (BAS-2), inflexible eating, and disordered eating. Additionally, path analyses were performed to examine mediation effects, with BMI controlled as a confounding variable, and the plausibility of the model was assessed using various goodness-of-fit indices and Bootstrap resampling.
